description.value: A popular BC Parks campground hugging the Little Qualicum River gorge, where impressive waterfalls cascade through old-growth forest and shaded riverside trails leave directly from the sites; Cameron Lake swimming and sailboarding are a 10-minute drive west on Highway 4.

address.value: 4001 Alberni Hwy, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1X7, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a BC Parks campground at Little Qualicum Falls Park, located 19km west of Parksville on Highway 4. The site prominently features a 'Book camping' button and a 'Reservation policies' section linking to frontcountry camping info, supporting reservations accepted. OSM provides capacity (41 sites), fee=yes, and operator info (R.L.C. Enterprize Ltd.). Most amenity details are not mentioned on the website, so they remain null. OSM tags like internet_access=no and power_supply=no are not treated as authoritative per rules.
concerns: Phone (+1-250-474-1336) and email (office@rlcparks.ca) in OSM belong to the private operator R.L.C. Enterprize Ltd., not BC Parks directly
OSM name specifies 'Lower Campground' but the website covers the entire Little Qualicum Falls Park; the park also has an upper campground that may be a separate listing
No address available in OSM or on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established BC Parks campground on Highway 4, a major trans-island cycling route. Touring cyclists riding between Parksville and Port Alberni would benefit from this listing.

wow_evidence: impressive waterfalls cascade through old-growth forest … located 19km west of Parksville on Highway 4
